message: Field "Post.number": native type "@db.ObjectId" is not supported, and Prisma 6 does not accept it on an Int field either. Remove it.

Field "Post.stamp": native type "@db.Timestamp" is not supported: Prisma 6 stores it as a BSON timestamp, and Prisma 8 has no codec for that BSON type. Remove it; this also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client then stores new DateTime values as BSON date instead of timestamp. Documents already stored keep their timestamp values, so rewrite them as dates before Prisma 8 reads them.
Field "Post.ratio": native type "@db.Decimal" is not supported, and Prisma 6 does not accept it on a Float field either. Remove it.
